articles.title: Trump's Democratic SEC pick suggests tokenization policy deserves full rule process

articles.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin
articles.snippet: The Truth Social owner bought back $100 million of convertible notes this week. Holders of the rest can demand cash on Nov. 30, and its bitcoin is worth just under $1 billion.

articles.title: 'Doomed From the Start': President Trump's Meme Coin Hits New Lows After Midterms
articles.snippet: The TRUMP token has fallen almost 40% since election day, with analysts pointing to the Democrats’ subpoena plans, fading interest, and a heavy unlock schedule.
